rule: All times are RFC3339 UTC with Z, microsecond precision maximum; enforce valid_from < valid_until, starts_at < ends_at and no future observed_at beyond 5 minutes.
All UUID references resolve in current tenant to specified kind and permissible version. Cross-tenant study uses verified local external_reference. No caller-controlled storage keys or tenant IDs.
Approved grant scope is a subset of requested scope and currently delegable rights, including cohort, fields, purpose, region, recipients and time. Null is not wildcard.
Import accepted + rejected + quarantined = source count; manifest source_count agrees; duplicate source row IDs cannot inflate accepted count.
Each immutable snapshot has its author verified person and digest; signer has assigned role and a distinct verified person. Same person through another login is still disallowed.

Observed ratio requires numerator >= 0, denominator > 0, numerator <= denominator and value = numerator/denominator within 1e-9. Missing/suppressed/invalid value must be null and reason present. Observed zero is valid.
Each schema kind must match endpoint domain. Resource PATCH replaces entire supplied payload; omission preserves it; prohibited keys reject, never silently drop.

A command context object/version pair is both null for a create, both non-null for an existing target. Command registry specifies which; target payload reference must equal context object where applicable.
Revocation, hold, retention and quarantine override positive grants. Recheck before replay, enqueue, execution, download and publication.
